steps.en: OCMS picks hirer notices that are due and not suspended.
steps.id: OCMS memilih notice hirer yang jatuh tempo dan tidak disuspend.

steps.en: The letter goes to the hirer's updated address; notices without an address are skipped.
steps.id: Surat dikirim ke alamat hirer yang sudah diperbarui; notice tanpa alamat dilewati.
steps.why_en: Hirers who only have a furnished address may lose the marker for their letter address after printing.
steps.why_id: Hirer yang hanya punya alamat hasil furnish bisa kehilangan penanda alamat surat setelah dicetak.

steps.en: OCMS builds the data file the vendor needs to print the letter.
steps.id: OCMS membuat file data yang dibutuhkan vendor untuk mencetak surat.

steps.en: OCMS is meant to send the file to the print vendor.
steps.id: OCMS seharusnya mengirim file ke vendor percetakan.
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is blocked by configuration, so the file does not reach them.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor diblokir lewat konfigurasi, jadi file tidak sampai ke mereka.

steps.en: The letter run should happen automatically as a scheduled job.
steps.id: Pengiriman surat seharusnya berjalan otomatis sebagai job terjadwal.
steps.why_en: The scheduled run no longer starts the letter job; it only runs when staff trigger it by hand.
steps.why_id: Job terjadwal tidak lagi menjalankan pembuatan surat; hanya jalan bila staf memicunya manual.

steps.en: The notice is recorded as informed and moves to the next stage.
steps.id: Notice dicatat sudah diinformasikan dan naik ke stage berikutnya.
steps.why_en: The notice advances even when the file never reached the vendor, so the hirer may not be informed.
steps.why_id: Notice tetap naik walau file tidak sampai ke vendor, jadi hirer bisa saja belum diberi tahu.
